title: GTA 6 Leaker Hunt: Take-Two Subpoenas Microsoft and Discord
description: Take-Two has initiated legal action in federal court, issuing subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord to identify the GTA 6 gameplay leaker.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Hunt for the GTA 6 Leaker Heats Up with New Legal Subpoenas

The investigation into the massive GTA 6 leaks is intensifying. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Take-Two has officially filed multiple subpoenas in a federal district court aimed at compelling tech giants Microsoft and Discord to hand over user data.

### Targeting Digital Footprints Across Platforms

The legal documents filed by Take-Two are reportedly seeking any data "sufficient to identify the users person." This sweeping request encompasses a wide variety of digital information, including OneDrive data, Xbox accounts, and Discord user details. The goal is to track down whatever trail might reveal the identity of the individual or individuals who leaked early GTA 6 gameplay videos online.

### Protecting Intellectual Property and Development Secrets

When early development footage of GTA 6 first surfaced online, it sent shockwaves through the gaming community. For developers and publishers like Rockstar Games and Take-Two, unauthorized leaks of unpolished gameplay can disrupt marketing strategies and compromise sensitive intellectual property. Resorting to federal court subpoenas demonstrates the company's firm commitment to holding those responsible accountable.

### Editor's Take

Protecting confidential game development data is critical for major studios. Take-Two's aggressive legal move against Microsoft and Discord sends a clear warning that leaking proprietary content will face serious legal consequences, reinforcing the industry's stance on copyright protection.
